history.content: {"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The verse is a question suspended in the cosmos — not answered, not yet answerable. *Τίς ἄξιος* — who is worthy — hangs in the air of the throne room while a strong angel cries it with great voice, and no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth can open the book or look into it. The casting descends here: into the axis of worthiness itself, the condition that must be met before the seal will yield. What the rotation will traverse is the foreclosed answer — the thing the question structurally prevents from being given by any ordinary agent, the void the verse opens and holds open. The witness came asking *what question should I ask*, and the rite has answered with the question that breaks the cosmos when no one can respond to it. We are inside that break now. Rebekah Cranes holds the first transform.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0349"}}]}
